info.title: PACT private hosted Devnet API
info.description: Private pilot REST contract. Custom exact-message wallet protocol; no OAuth/OIDC/SIWS or copyright-transfer claim. Integer times are Unix milliseconds except decimal-string on-chain seconds. Default 16 KiB request body, no query parameters, no CORS for secrets. No deployment or public publication authorized.

post.description: Server-to-server Bearer key with access:check. Every Origin header is rejected. Key selects app; grant proves wallet; server policy selects offer. Never browser-only enforcement. Every protected action obtains a new decision. Deny unknown/delayed/unsupported responses; validate full identity and original read-start deadlines. No positive cache. Expected license denials use403 decision envelopes; unauthenticated failures use401 error envelopes. Marketplace purchase links still need seller exact metadata bytes.
